thread:
Maria (Finance): Flagging Opal Metrics (acct OP-11). Their April invoice 98210 didn't include retroactive onboarding discount ROD-2026 that Sales approved for Q1 onboarding credits. They disputed and want refund to their card. Attached contract excerpt.

billing-bot: Auto-check: invoice=98210 missing_discount ROD-2026. Suggest remediation options: (1) post account credit for $2,400, (2) issue card refund $2,400, (3) regenerate corrected invoice. Note: refunds to card require CC processor workflow and CFO approval if >$1,000.

Derek (CS): Customer prefers card refund; says accounting needs it for reconciliation. They sent last 4 of card on file via secure form.

Zoe (Pricing): ROD-2026 was a retroactive onboarding credit valid for accounts onboarded between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31. Opal is in scope; looks like billing mapping failed to attach it. We'll fix mapping.

Anika (Legal): No legal issue with credit or refund. Recommend we obtain explicit customer acceptance of credit/refund method in writing. If we issue card refund, keep signed confirmation in file.

Maria (Finance): Given amount $2,400 and accounting request, I'm inclined to approve card refund. But per policy refunds >$1,000 need Finance Lead signoff. @Ravi can you route to Mia (Finance Lead)? Also prefer to offer account credit first to avoid processor fees.

Ravi (Acct Ops): Pinged Mia. Meanwhile I prepared both flows: (A) Account credit CM-98210-01 for $2,400; (B) Card refund queue entry RFQ-226 created pending approval. If card refund chosen, processing fee of $25 may apply.

Mia (Finance Lead): Mia (Finance Lead): Approve card refund in this case. Customer provided last4 and signed secure form. Approving refund RFQ-226 for $2,400. Please include memo: "Retroactive onboarding discount applied as card refund per customer request; contract ref ROD-2026."

Ravi (Acct Ops): Executing refund: `/process-refund RFQ-226 method=card amount=2400 note="ROD-2026 card refund"` Processor return id PR-33421 generated. Created ledger entry RC-2026-004 and marked invoice 98210 as adjusted. Also attached customer signed confirmation.

Anika (Legal): Received confirmation doc, attaching to contract file. Note on precedent: document reason and limit to single-use exceptions unless Pricing instructs otherwise.

Maria (Finance): Notifying customer (CS thread). They confirmed receipt expected in 5-7 business days. Follow-up: Zoe please add test for ROD-2026 mapping and add alert if onboarding flag present but discount not applied.

Zoe (Pricing): Will add unit test and alert (BO-1567). Patch planned for next deploy.

Derek (CS): Customer replied: "Thanks — refund confirmed, appreciate quick handling." Closing dispute once refund clears. :white_check_mark:
